test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Prabhat, Dinesh, Yug, Monu, Sakshi, Amit and Shipra are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Yug sits second to the left of Amit. Prabhat sits third to the right of Amit. Monu sits to the immediate right of Dinesh. Shipra is not an immediate neighbour of Prabhat. Who sits second to the left of Dinesh?
solution:
**Given:** Prabhat, Dinesh, Yug, Monu, Sakshi, Amit and Shipra are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 

1) Yug sits second to the left of Amit.

2) Prabhat sits third to the right of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43d4811fe5dcc6d75e757012753c33d604047560255a9f78e46985abcc00e9ff.png] 

3) Monu sits to the immediate right of Dinesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3e9f6164fc4ffedc5c8ad8f70a261496685a43e3340e59d19b002e6d88cfab.png] 

4) Shipra is not an immediate neighbour of Prabhat.

After positioning Shipra only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Sakshi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce67babd48b7fea0de597703a747026e7b2e682eaa402d7d60876111f988aee.png] 

Thus, Shipra sits second to the left of Dinesh.​

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
